title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 189 ]

blocks.text: Buy Nothing Day is an international day for buying nothing at all. It asks us to think about what we buy and whether buying more actually increases our quality of life. Every product we buy has an effect on the environment. Even before we spend our money, making, advertising, and packaging what we buy can cost a lot in pure water, air, and soil. In short, our shopping habits can have considerable effects on the environment.

readingSentences.english: Buy Nothing Day is an international day for buying nothing at all.
readingSentences.korean: '아무것도 사지 않는 날'은 전혀 아무것도 사지 않는 국제적인 날이다.

readingSentences.english: It asks us to think about what we buy and whether buying more actually increases our quality of life.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 우리가 무엇을 사는지, 그리고 더 많이 사는 것이 실제로 우리의 삶의 질을 높여주는지 생각해 보게 한다.

readingSentences.english: Every product we buy has an effect on the environment.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 사는 모든 제품은 환경에 영향을 미친다.

readingSentences.english: Even before we spend our money, making, advertising, and packaging what we buy can cost a lot in pure water, air, and soil.
readingSentences.korean: 우리가 돈을 쓰기도 전에, 우리가 사는 물건을 만들고 광고하고 포장하는 데 깨끗한 물, 공기, 흙이 많이 희생될 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: In short, our shopping habits can have considerable effects on the environment.
readingSentences.korean: 요컨대 우리의 쇼핑 습관은 환경에 상당한 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
